description: This file contains PowerPC assembly implementations of standard string functions such as strcpy, strncpy, strcat, strchr, strcmp, strncmp, strlen, memset, memmove, memcpy, memchr, memcmp, as well as cache management routines like flush_cache.

methods.name: strcpy
methods.description: Copies a null-terminated string from source to destination.

methods.name: strncpy
methods.description: Copies up to a specified number of characters from source to destination.

methods.name: strcat
methods.description: Concatenates string src to string dest.

methods.name: strchr
methods.description: Finds the first occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: strncmp
methods.description: Compares up to n characters of two strings.

methods.name: strlen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string.

methods.name: memset
methods.description: Fills a block of memory with a specified byte.

methods.name: memmove
methods.description: Copies memory area, safe for overlapping regions.

methods.name: memcpy
methods.description: Copies memory area, assumes non-overlapping regions.

methods.name: memchr
methods.description: Searches for a byte in a block of memory.

methods.name: flush_cache
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates cache lines over a range of addresses.
